_meta.purpose: Service fingerprints for Phase 3 subdomain-takeover CANDIDATE detection. A match means a dangling CNAME is pointing at a service whose resource appears unclaimed — it is a SIGNAL, never proof. Every match is reported as a candidate requiring manual, in-scope validation; the skill never auto-claims a resource.
_meta.usage_note: Provider reclamation policies change frequently. Treat this file as a starting set and reconcile against can-i-take-over-xyz and a maintained scanner (subzy / dnsReaper / nuclei takeover templates) before relying on a 'status'. Prefer those tools' built-in signatures for breadth; this file documents the high-signal cases and their caveats.

status_values.vulnerable: Service is commonly claimable when the fingerprint shows and the DNS record dangles.
status_values.edge: Takeover possible only under specific conditions, or provider has partial mitigations (e.g. domain-verification TXT). Validate carefully; high false-positive risk.
status_values.not_currently: Historically vulnerable but provider mitigations now generally prevent takeover. Kept for awareness; expect false positives, do not report without strong proof.

_meta.fingerprint_caveat: A fingerprint string is a strong hint, not confirmation. Always confirm the dangling CNAME (dig CNAME <host>) AND that the backing resource is genuinely registrable before reporting. Some providers (Fastly, AWS) use Host-header virtual hosting, so a generic error page is not always a takeover.

fingerprints: There isn't a GitHub Pages site here.
For root URLs (like http://example.com/) you must provide an index.html file
signatures.notes: Takeover now requires registering an account whose username matches the target's <username>.github.io subdomain, which is rarely available. Treat matches as low-probability and validate the username is actually claimable before reporting.
Heroku added protections; takeover depends on the app name being re-registrable. Confirm the app name is free in Heroku before reporting.

fingerprints: The specified bucket does not exist
signatures.notes: Classic case. The bucket name must be globally re-creatable in S3. Note the supply-chain angle: a reclaimed bucket that previously served JS/assets referenced by pipelines can become a supply-chain vector — flag these higher. Bucket names are region-global; verify availability.

fingerprints: Please check that this domain has been added to a service
signatures.notes: Fastly uses Host-header virtual hosting, so the error alone is not proof — many live sites can momentarily show it. Confirm the domain can actually be added to an attacker-controlled Fastly service.

fingerprints: The specified blob does not exist
signatures.notes: Azure supports domain-verification TXT records (asuid.<sub> TXT) that, if the org left them in place, BLOCK takeover even on a dangling CNAME. Check for the asuid TXT before reporting. Subdominator/baddns are stronger than generic scanners for Azure surfaces.

fingerprints: Sorry, this shop is currently unavailable
signatures.notes: Shopify added DNS-verification mitigations; takeover often requires the store slug to be re-registrable and may need support interaction. Validate carefully.
Project name re-registrable via surge CLI. Confirm the project name is free.
Confirm the corresponding Bitbucket repo/workspace is registrable.

fingerprints: The thing you were looking for is no longer here, or never was
signatures.notes: Subdomain must be re-creatable on Ghost(Pro). Validate availability.
Validate that the project domain can be claimed in a Tilda account.

fingerprints: The requested URL was not found on this server
signatures.notes: Validate the page/domain can be re-added in Unbounce.

fingerprints: The page you are looking for doesn't exist or has been moved
signatures.notes: Generic error string — high false-positive risk. Confirm the custom domain is addable in a Webflow project before reporting.

fingerprints: The gods are wise, but do not know of the site which you seek
signatures.notes: Confirm the site name is registrable on Pantheon.
Validate the target subdomain/site is re-registrable.

fingerprints: No settings were found for this company
signatures.notes: Validate the docs site can be claimed.

fingerprints: If you're moving your domain away from Cargo
signatures.notes: Generic 404 — corroborate with the Cargo-specific string and registrability.
Netlify has mitigations; takeover requires the site name to be free and added to an attacker site. High false-positive risk on generic strings — validate.
